paragraphs: R' Redifa and R' Aha in R' Bun bar Kahana's name: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Metzi'at Ha-Ishah. Also R' Yonah in R' Huna's name: Pesahim chapter 4; At the beginning of Yerushalmi Sotah chapter 2, R' Redifa and R' Yonah report Rav Huna’s teaching. R' Yonah in R' Ila's name: Yevamot 1:2. R' Redifa and R' Yonah report R' Yirmeyah’s question near the end of Yerushalmi Ketubbot, Ha-Maddir, and in Yerushalmi Kiddushin (cited here as 2:5, located at 2:4). R' Redifa reported a question from R' Nisa at the end of the first chapter of Yerushalmi Eruvin.
